meta.description: Curated step-free / lift accessibility data for major Japanese train and metro stations. v1 grows in tourist-priority batches.
meta.disclaimer: Community seed dataset. Lift availability can change due to maintenance or construction. Always verify with the official operator before you travel if you rely on step-free access.

stations.name: Tokyo

entrances.exit: Marunouchi North Exit / Yaesu Central-North area
entrances.liftLocation: Platform 4 (Yamanote inner loop): Elevator C at Kanda-direction side connects 2F-1F-B1F. Platform 5 (Yamanote outer loop): Elevator E at Kanda-direction side connects 2F-1F-B1F.
entrances.notes: Elevators C and E connect to Marunouchi Underground exits and Yaesu Underground Central exit via B1F. JR East confirms elevators, but detailed per-exit mapping is partly image-based.
entrances.sourceTitle: 駅構内図・バリアフリー情報(東京駅) - JR東日本

entrances.exit: Marunouchi South Exit / Yaesu South area
entrances.liftLocation: Platform 4 (Yamanote inner loop): Elevator B at Yurakucho-direction side connects 2F-1F. Platform 5 (Yamanote outer loop): Elevator D at Yurakucho-direction side connects 2F-1F.
entrances.notes: Elevators B and D do not connect to B1F; use them for Marunouchi South and Yaesu South ground-level exits only.
entrances.sourceTitle: 駅構内図・バリアフリー情報(東京駅) - JR東日本

entrances.liftLocation: Outside ticket gates, within Oazo building, connecting concourse to Exit M10-5 street level.
entrances.notes: Operating hours: 10:00 to last train. Requires the inside-gate elevator from platform center to ticket-gate level.
entrances.sourceTitle: バリアフリー設備 | 東京駅/M17 | 東京メトロ

entrances.liftLocation: Outside ticket gates, elevator-only exit toward Marubiru (Maru Building) direction.
entrances.notes: Operating hours: first train to 24:00. Requires the inside-gate elevator from platform center to ticket-gate level.
entrances.sourceTitle: バリアフリー設備 | 東京駅/M17 | 東京メトロ

stations.researchNotes: JR East conventional-line detail is medium confidence where exact per-exit mapping is image-based. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line route is high confidence.

stations.name: Ginza
stations.touristArea: Ginza shopping district / Ginza Six / Wako

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Ginza-yonchome Intersection Gate, elevator to Exit A7 street level.
entrances.notes: Full route: platform 1 to Ginza-yonchome Intersection Gate to Exit A7. Elevator inside gate connects platform to gate; elevator outside gate connects gate to street.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Ginza Station/G09/M16/H09

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Ginza-yonchome Intersection Gate (Ginza Line) or Central Gate (Hibiya Line), elevator to Exit B2 street level.
entrances.notes: Operating hours restricted: 6:00 to 22:00 for Ginza Line route. Hibiya Line route uses platform (central) to Central Gate to Exit B2.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Ginza Station/G09/M16/H09

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Sukiyabashi Intersection Gate, elevator to street-level elevator-only exit.
entrances.notes: Full route: Marunouchi Line platform (central) to Sukiyabashi Intersection Gate to elevator-only exit.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Ginza Station/G09/M16/H09

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Central Gate, elevator to Exit B8 street level.
entrances.notes: Operating hours restricted: Monday 7:00-23:00, Tuesday-Friday 6:00-23:00, Saturday 6:00-22:00, Sunday 8:00-21:00.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Ginza Station/G09/M16/H09

stations.researchNotes: All three Tokyo Metro lines have confirmed one-route step-free access. Some exits have restricted operating hours; inter-line transfers may require multiple elevator routes.

stations.name: Yurakucho

entrances.liftLocation: JR East Central Exit area, elevator connecting 1F and 2F levels to platforms.
entrances.notes: JR East confirms Central Exit elevator route to all platforms. Other JR exits without elevator access include Central West, International Forum, Ginza, and Hibiya exits.
entrances.sourceTitle: 駅構内図・バリアフリー情報(有楽町駅) - JR東日本

entrances.liftLocation: JR East Kyobashi Exit area, elevator connecting 1F and 2F levels to platforms.
entrances.notes: JR East confirms Kyobashi Exit elevator route to all platforms.
entrances.sourceTitle: 駅構内図・バリアフリー情報(有楽町駅) - JR東日本

entrances.liftLocation: Outside JR Yurakucho Station Gate, elevator to Exit 7 street level.
entrances.notes: Full route: Yurakucho Line platform (central) to inside-gate elevator to gate level, then outside-gate elevator to Exit 7. JR/Metro transfer is not a single step-free route; use surface streets.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Yurakucho Station/Y18 | Tokyo Metro

stations.researchNotes: JR and Metro are both step-free individually, but transfer is via different exits and surface streets.

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Takashimaya Gate, elevator to Exit B0.

entrances.notes: Full route: Ginza Line platform to Gofukubashi Intersection Gate to Exit B9.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Nihombashi Station/G11/T10

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Gofukubashi Intersection Gate, elevator to Exit A7.
toPlatforms: Tozai Line platform (via Gofukubashi Intersection Gate)
entrances.notes: Operating hours: 7:00 to 23:30.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Nihombashi Station/G11/T10

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Gofukubashi Intersection Gate, elevator to Exit A4.
toPlatforms: Tozai Line platform (via Gofukubashi Intersection Gate)
entrances.notes: Operating hours: 6:00 to 23:30.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Nihombashi Station/G11/T10

stations.researchNotes: Tokyo Metro Ginza and Tozai routes are high confidence. Toei Asakusa Line exact elevator/exit data was not verified from official Toei page.

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Central East Gate, elevator to Exit B2c within Oazo Building.

entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Otemachi Station/M18/T09/C11/Z08

entrances.notes: Full route: Tozai Line platform (central) to West Gate to Exit B1/B1a.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Otemachi Station/M18/T09/C11/Z08

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Hibiya-dori Avenue Gate, elevator to Exit C14.
entrances.notes: Full route: Chiyoda Line platform (central) to Hibiya-dori Avenue Gate to Exit C14.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Otemachi Station/M18/T09/C11/Z08

entrances.liftLocation: Outside Sankei-mae Intersection Gate, elevator to Exit E1 (Tokyo Sankei Building).
entrances.notes: Operating hours: 7:00 to 22:30. Full route: Hanzomon Line platform to connecting passage to Sankei-mae Intersection Gate to Exit E1.

entrances.liftLocation: Toei Mita Line platform area; elevator connects platform to concourse to street level.
entrances.notes: Toei confirms 3 elevators and 1 step-free route at Otemachi Mita Line station, but exact exit number is not specified on the official Toei page.
entrances.sourceTitle: 大手町 | 東京都交通局

stations.researchNotes: Tokyo Metro lines are high confidence. Toei Mita line is confirmed step-free but exact exit number is medium confidence. Inter-line transfers can involve long detours.

stations.name: Shimbashi

entrances.liftLocation: Outside JR Shimbashi Station ticket gates, elevator connecting B1F concourse to 1F street level.
entrances.notes: Full route: Ginza Line platforms 1 and 2 (Asakusa side) to inside-gate elevator B2F-B1F, then outside-gate elevator B1F-1F.
entrances.sourceTitle: バリアフリー設備 | 新橋駅/G08 | 東京メトロ

entrances.liftLocation: Toei Asakusa Line platform and ground level; elevators connect platform to concourse to street.
entrances.notes: Toei confirms 2 elevators and 1 step-free route. Specific exit numbers are not listed on the official Toei page.
entrances.sourceTitle: 新橋 | 東京都交通局

entrances.liftLocation: JR East Shimbashi Station has elevators confirmed; Karasumori Exit side elevator to pedestrian deck level noted by ecomo-rakuraku.
entrances.notes: JR East confirms elevators exist, but exact per-exit elevator details are image-based on the official page.
entrances.sourceTitle: 駅構内図・バリアフリー情報(新橋駅) - JR東日本

stations.researchNotes: Metro Ginza route is high confidence. JR East and Toei confirm elevators but exact exit-level detail is medium confidence. Yurikamome Shimbashi not verified in this batch.

stations.name: Shiodome
stations.touristArea: Shiodome City Center / Caretta Shiodome / Nittele Tower

entrances.liftLocation: Toei Oedo Line station; ground-level elevator connects street to concourse/ticket gate level; platform-level elevator connects concourse to platform.
toPlatforms: Oedo Line platform (island platform, both directions)
entrances.notes: Toei confirms 3 elevators and 1 step-free route. Specific exit numbers are not listed on the official Toei page.
entrances.sourceTitle: 汐留 | 東京都交通局

entrances.liftLocation: Yurikamome elevated station; elevator connects platform level to ticket gate level, and ticket gate level connects to Toei Oedo Line and ground level.
entrances.notes: Yurikamome official site confirms barrier-free facilities generally, but exact station-specific elevator location was verified via secondary source. Transfer between Toei Oedo and Yurikamome requires exiting to ground level.
entrances.sourceTitle: Shiodome | Yurikamome line

stations.researchNotes: Toei and Yurikamome are both step-free individually, but transfer is not directly linked and exact exits are medium confidence.

stations.name: Higashi-ginza

entrances.liftLocation: Exit 3, ground-level elevator available (Tokyo Metro exit guide marks this exit as having a ground-level elevator).
entrances.notes: Inside-gate elevator connects platform (central) to concourse; outside-gate elevator connects concourse to street via Exit 3.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Higashi-ginza Station/H10 | Tokyo Metro

entrances.liftLocation: Toei Asakusa Line station; ground-level elevator and platform-level elevator.
entrances.notes: Toei confirms 2 elevators and 1 step-free route. Specific exit numbers are not provided on the official Toei page.
entrances.sourceTitle: 東銀座 | 東京都交通局

stations.researchNotes: Tokyo Metro Hibiya route is high confidence. Toei Asakusa route is confirmed step-free but exact exit details are medium confidence.

stations.name: Tsukiji
stations.touristArea: Tsukiji / Tsukiji Hongan-ji Temple / Former fish market area

entrances.liftLocation: Inside gate: elevator connects platform (central) to Tsukiji-honganji Gate. Outside gate: elevator connects gate level to street exit.
entrances.notes: Tokyo Metro confirms one-route step-free elevator access for Hibiya Line.
entrances.sourceTitle: Barrier-Free Facilities | Tsukiji Station/H11 | Tokyo Metro

stations.researchNotes: Exact exit number is not explicit on the English page; the route is via Tsukiji-honganji Gate.
